root: ^Loras: Bartolomeu... you’re still alive... in a manner of speaking.
^Loras: Bartolomeu? Hm. I guess so. He was never much of a lively one, to be fair.
^Cacildes: Is there someone else on the island?
^Loras: Could be friend... or foe. With Bartolomeu out cold, we might have a bit of time to spare.
^Cacildes: Right. I’ll check out that cavern. We might uncover more about this hidden city — maybe even a passage.
^Loras: I like your spirit, kid. Lead the way.
